description.value: This McDonald's, branded internally as the 'TV Towers' branch, sits on Robson Street in central Vancouver near the entertainment and shopping district. It is a dine-in location with both indoor and outdoor seating and no drive-through. As a 24/7 urban fast-food stop it offers a reliable resupply point for cyclists passing through the city core.
